mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT(om.SERIE, ' ', om.CHNR) AS chassisNo, om.MODEL AS model, om.BUILD AS buildWeek, vda.PRODUCT_TYPE AS productType, vda.VIN AS vin, vda.COUNTRY_OF_OPERATION AS countryOfOperation, var.FAMILY_ID AS familyId, var.VARIANT_ID AS variantId, om.CUSTOMER_ADAP AS sNoteNo FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_OM om INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_GENERAL vda ON om.SERIE = vda.SERIE AND om.CHNR = vda.CHNR INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_VARIANTS var ON om.SERIE = var.SERIE AND om.CHNR = var.CHNR WHERE om.SERIE = #{serie} AND om.CHNR = #{chnr} LIMIT 1

SELECT 'A01' AS engineNo, RPAD(SUBSTRING(kv.SYMBOL, 1, 8), 8, ' ') AS symbolStr, kv.DESCRIPTION AS description FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_KOLA_VARIANT kv WHERE kv.FAMILY_ID = #{familyId} AND kv.VARIANT_ID = #{variantId} LIMIT 1
